radiusSource: Radius 0.12 solar radii: the model radius Climent et al. (2022, A&A 660, A65; arXiv:2201.12606) adopt for each component (Chabrier et al. 2000 models; 0.12 to 0.14 over the pair's age and mass ranges). 83,484 km. GM: half the dynamical total mass 0.141 +/- 0.008 solar masses (Dupuy et al. 2023, Table 3), as for A: the pair is nearly equal in brightness and its mass ratio poorly constrained. Temperature 2700 K: Dupuy et al.'s best BT-Settl model to the pair's combined spectrum.
orbitalPeriodSource: Dupuy et al. P = 7.307 +0.023/-0.024 yr of 365.25 d.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published model radius. VHS 1256-1257 B's disc is not resolved and no image of it exists; its colour is a blackbody at the published temperature, 2,700 K.

effectiveTemperatureSource: 2700 K: the best-fitting BT-Settl model to the pair's combined spectrum, Dupuy et al. (2023), section 4, https://arxiv.org/abs/2208.08448
